data.title: Signal integration by mTORC1 coordinates nutrient input with biosynthetic output
data.authors: Dibble CC; Manning BD et al.

evidence.label: Review — secondary literature, not a new result
evidence.note: this describes the kind of study, not its quality

data.finding: Review: mTORC1 integrates nutrient input with biosynthetic output.
data.abstract_excerpt: Flux through metabolic pathways is inherently sensitive to the levels of specific substrates and products, but cellular metabolism is also managed by integrated control mechanisms that sense the nutrient and energy status of a cell or organism. The mechanistic target of rapamycin complex 1 (mTORC1), a protein kinase complex ubiquitous to eukaryotic cells, has emerged as a critical signalling node that links nutrient sensing to the coordinated regulation of cellular metabolism.
